Metapod?! |pokemonname=Butterfree |current=[[Party|With Yellow]] |va=no }} '''Kitty''' (Japanese: '''ピーすけ''' ''Piisuke''), known as '''Freesk''' in [[Chuang Yi]]'s translation of the {{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}, is a {{p|Butterfree}} that {{adv|Yellow}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and her sixth {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} overall. As of ''[[PS290|A Well-Journeyed Jumpluff]]'', he is at [[level]] 20, and his [[Characteristic]] is that he is "impetuous and silly." ==History== ==={{MangaArc|Yellow}}=== [[File:Yellow and Kitty.png|thumb|left|150px|right|Kitty and Yellow]] Kitty first appears as a Caterpie in ''[[PS049|As Gastly as Before]]''. He is first seen in a tree and is about to be attacked by a {{m|Fire Blast}} launched by {{adv|Blaine}}'s {{p|Growlithe}}, which was attacking [[Agatha]]'s {{p|Gastly}}. {{adv|Yellow}} immediately jumps into action and sent [[Pika]] to rescue him by means of her fishing rod. After this, Yellow leaves with {{adv|Blue}} to go train, with Caterpie watching her go. In ''[[PS053|Can't Catch Caterpie!]]'', Caterpie is revealed to have followed Yellow all the way from [[Celadon City]]. Blue tells Yellow to capture him and train him to a higher level. Yellow then sends out [[Ratty]] to try to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} him. The two spent all day trying but could not find a way to do it without hurting him. Blue eventually steps in and helps the two capture Caterpie, which she [[nickname]]s Kitty. In the [[PS054|next chapter]], Yellow leaves Kitty with Pika as she goes off to run an errand. After Yellow races off Kitty spots a leaf floating past, and chases after it. The leaf floats over to the edge of the cliff, so Pika chases after Kitty to stop him from falling off the edge. Kitty then chases the leaf and almost runs into a cactus. Pika runs in front of Kitty and blows the leaf away, with then flies off in a gust of wind. Pika finds another leaf and gives it to Kitty when suddenly a herd of {{p|Pidgeotto}} fly past and pick Kitty up in the process. Pika climbs the cliff, and then jumps off and shocks the Pidgeotto. The Pidgeotto drops Kitty, and Pika catches him, with Kitty looking very distressed. They land next to a tree and some flowers, and Kitty eats all the flowers, recovering his health and cheerfulness. The two then promptly fall asleep. [[File:Yellow battling Lance.png|thumb|200px|Kitty battling Lance]] In ''[[PS057|Ekans the Ecstasy]]'', Kitty uses his {{m|String Shot}} to help save the passengers of the sinking [[S.S. Anne]]. In ''[[PS082|Eradicate Raticate!]]'', Kitty is sent out alongside his teammates to battle against [[Lance]] and his {{TP|Lance|Dragonite}}. Kitty attacks with String Shot, but {{p|Dragonite}} simply shrugs it off and throws Kitty away. He is [[PS087|later]] used in a team attack to try and stop Lance from shooting bubbles. Yellow had Kitty cover the volcano crater in String Shot to form a net that is doused by her [[Omny]]'s water, linked to Ratty's sensitive whiskers. Upon Lance triggering the net, Ratty signals to Pika to send electricity down the net, forcing Lance's bubble into view. Yellow then orders [[Dody]] to break the bubble with {{m|Drill Peck}}, but the attack proves too weak. In the final battle against [[Lance]] in ''[[PS089|The Might of... Metapod?!]]'', after Yellow had lost the [[Pokédex]], Kitty [[Evolution|evolves]] into a Metapod to shield Yellow from a {{m|Hyper Beam}}, then immediately into a Butterfree at the same time as all of Yellow's other Pokémon. As a Butterfree, he carried her aloft, allowing her to conduct an aerial battle during the [[PS090|final confrontation]] with Lance on and above the back of the {{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Lugia|Legendary Pokémon}}. ==={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}=== In ''[[PS141|Hello, Lickitung]]'', Kitty rescued Yellow from a group of {{p|Lickitung}}. In ''[[PS173|The Last Battle VII]]'', he defended the {{pkmn|Day Care}} Center with the rest of her Pokémon from the half-masked [[Team Rocket]] Grunts. ==={{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}=== Kitty is seen briefly in ''[[PS292|Bested by Banette]]'', helping Yellow catch up to [[Sird]] and [[Orm]], who had captured {{adv|Silver}}. In ''[[PS302|Phew for Mew]]'', Kitty and Yellow found themselves petrified by [[Sird]], along with the four other [[Pokédex holder]]s and their Pokémon. ==={{MangaArc|Emerald}}=== In ''[[PS334|The Final Battle VII]]'', Yellow checked on Kitty and the rest of her team to ensure they all survived the petrification caused by {{adv|Mewtwo}} and {{p|Darkrai}}. ==Personality and characteristics== [[File:Kitty fishing line Adventures.png|thumb|175px|Kitty using his String Shot as a fishing line]] As a Caterpie, Kitty was shown to be very ditsy and easily distracted. He would often wander around and get himself into dangerous situations, usually resulting in [[Pika]] getting hurt but Kitty walking away unharmed. Kitty has also been shown to be extremely affectionate of {{adv|Yellow}}, shown when he followed her all the way from [[Celadon City]] just to stay with her. Kitty can frequently be seen rubbing affectionately against Yellow or wagging his tail happily. Yellow often uses Kitty's {{m|String Shot}} in a variety of ways to help her out.
